titles.en: Stone Terrace Classic of Filial Piety

attribution.name: 李亨
attribution.note: The crown prince, later Emperor Suzong, wrote the seal-script heading.
attribution.noteZh: 时为太子的李亨（后为唐肃宗）篆额。

background: The emperor’s own preface, commentary, and clerical-script text of the Classic of Filial Piety, assembled from 35 blocks into a stele with a three-tiered base. The heading in seal script is by Li Heng (Emperor Suzong).

review.note: Draft work record from the museum page. The attribution of the seal-script heading rests on the same page.
review.noteZh: 依据馆方页面整理的草稿；碑额篆书归属同样仅据该页面。

notes: The page does not state the number of characters or the condition of the carving today.
